mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM ums_department d INNER JOIN ums_role_department_relation rdr ON d.id = rdr.department_id WHERE rdr.role_id = #{roleId} AND d.status = 1 ORDER BY d.sort ASC, d.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT d.* FROM ums_department d INNER JOIN ums_role_department_relation rdr ON d.id = rdr.department_id INNER JOIN ums_admin_role_relation arr ON rdr.role_id = arr.role_id WHERE arr.admin_id = #{adminId} AND d.status = 1 ORDER BY d.sort ASC, d.id ASC
